I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or contradict the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

- **What I checked:** the #central-team history and the shared files she can see. Neither mentions Brackenwater at all. There's no account folder, contract or CRM note.
- **What I told her:** treat the date as unverified until someone checks the signed contract or asks the account owner. I also asked her to post the date in the channel once it's confirmed.
- **Knowledge brain:** my search was refused because this connection isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read from it. I left that alone because fixing it means changing access on the brain host. If you want brain lookups to work, someone needs to run `gbrain auth rescope` there.

Nothing was recorded anywhere as the renewal date.
